verdict.rationale: Mailgun itself has no native recurring-job or workflow scheduler; the only evidence pointing toward scheduling is its n8n integration doc claiming users can 'send, schedule, and track emails without writing code,' which delegates scheduling to a third-party automation tool rather than Mailgun natively. Missing for 10: native cron-like scheduling API, first-party recurring send/workflow feature, and independent confirmation that n8n-based scheduling works reliably.
